    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Controller sequencing state and refill offset",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "ctrl.state and ctrl.ofs only order refill and response steps or point to the next word, so the Sequencing state rule excludes them as information of their own."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Forwarded transaction data and handshake",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The request and response data and handshake fields are transferred between unit ports and the backing cache or bus without being stored or computed by this unit, so Forwarded transactions and Transfer records exclude them as separate concepts."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Cache geometry and read-only build configuration",

    }
